assertions.text: No hardcoded credentials or secrets appear in the YAML
Every connection: value follows the required name_XXXXX suffix format, a ${{ ENV.* }} reference, or explicit null — never a bare invented name

Connection names follow the required descriptive-name_XXXXX suffix format rather than being invented ad hoc, and no connection is fabricated for a resource the source code doesn't actually reference (connection: null when there is none)

A parameter that duplicates connection-level scope (e.g. a workspace/account/host id) is only set to an explicit literal/input/${{ ENV.* }} value when the source genuinely varies it per task; otherwise it is left null/omitted so the connection's own configured default applies
